# RFC 8091 JSON Sequence Media Type Reference

Agent uses this reference for endpoints or tools that stream multiple JSON texts over one response body.

## When to Use

| Condition | Agent Action |
|---|---|
| Response streams multiple JSON objects over time | Use this reference |
| Endpoint returns one JSON document only | Use `rfc-8259.md` |
| Error contract changes before stream start | Pair with `rfc-9457.md` |

## Core Rules

| Rule | Agent Verifies | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| RFC8091-001 | Media type is `application/json-seq` | Set response content type explicitly |
| RFC8091-002 | Each frame is one complete JSON text | Serialize full objects per frame |
| RFC8091-003 | Record-separator framing is present | Write RFC 8091 frame boundaries |
| RFC8091-004 | Pre-stream validation completes first | Validate request before first frame |
| RFC8091-005 | Post-start failures stop the stream safely | Terminate stream and log correlation data |
| RFC8091-006 | Cancellation flows through writes | Pass request cancellation token |
| RFC8091-007 | Producer flushes when low latency matters | Flush after each frame when contract requires it |

## Workflow

| Step | Agent Action | Test | Pass |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. Classify stream | Agent identifies streamed endpoints, writers, and serializers in scope. | Agent lists changed streaming paths. | Every changed streaming path appears once. |
| 2. Normalize framing | Agent sets `application/json-seq` and one full JSON text per frame. | Inspect changed writer code or streaming tests. | Each emitted frame is independently parseable JSON. |
| 3. Protect failure path | Agent returns Problem Details before stream start or stops safely after start. | Run existing streaming or API tests in scope. | Pre-stream errors return normal HTTP errors; post-start failures do not inject ad hoc JSON. |
| 4. Verify behavior | Agent runs existing build and streaming tests in scope. | Run existing build and test commands in scope. | Zero build errors and zero failing tests. |

## Verification Matrix

| Test | Run | Pass |
|---|---|---|
| Media type verification | Inspect response headers in existing streaming tests. | Header is `application/json-seq`. |
| Frame verification | Consume a streamed response in existing tests or tooling. | Every frame parses as one complete JSON text. |
| Error-path verification | Trigger one validation error before stream start. | Service returns normal error response instead of partial stream bytes. |

## Guardrails

- Agent does not concatenate partial JSON fragments.
- Agent does not inject Problem Details into an active JSON sequence body.
- Agent keeps frame envelopes backward compatible inside changed scope.
